2459-5006-5231-8170.description:

1981-4476-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-4476-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

5531-5694-6664-7874-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5531-5694-6664-7874-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the The Immortal Weapons trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
5531-5694-6664-7874-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink The Immortal Weapons and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

728-3179-3249-4549--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding an additional mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.

3918-4131-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Clues.
3918-4131-5527.notes: Once you have extra mana, Basalt Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

413-2528-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
413-2528-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance and tapping it, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
When Emeritus of Abundance enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation and tapping it, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

152-4131-7343.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith.
Activate the Basalt Monolith token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate the Basalt Monolith token's second ability by paying {2} due to Mutagen Man, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the basic land and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-2423-4613-4679--128.description:

When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
"Human" or "Soldier" chosen with Urza's Incubator.

Resolve the Battalion Foot Soldier trigger from step 2, searching your library for Battalion Foot Soldier and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.

280-751-3314-3470.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Human Soldiers, adding {1}{W}.

1636-1999-3910-4050.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1999-3910-4050.description:

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {U}.

Once you have infinite creature tokens and infinite colored mana, you may activate Breya's ability infinite times.

907-1479-2374.description:

When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Maja, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Maja trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
